question.text: The maximum value of the function $f(x)=2 x^3-15 x^2+36 x-48$ on the set $A=\left\{x \mid x^2+20 \leq 9 x\right\}$ is

solution.text:
Given, $\quad A=\left\{x \mid x^2+20 \leq 9 x\right\}$ $=\{x \mid x \in[4,5]\}$ Now, $f^{\prime}(x)=6\left(x^2-5 x+6\right)$ Put $\quad f^{\prime}(x)=0 \Rightarrow x=2,3$ $f(2)=-20, f(3)=-21$, $f(4)=-16, f(5)=7$
From graph, maximum of $f(x)$ on set $A$ is $f(5)=7$.
